basis: Local source review and synthetic tests; production rollout and real-report reconciliation remain pending.

global_rules.authorization: Existing AI enablement, company subscription, module-specific seat rules, role permissions and record scope must all pass. Only authenticated Admin/Super Admin can report company records within their own company; every other role is self-only. Team scope is unavailable. A subscription alone grants no additional record scope.
global_rules.tenant_isolation: Authenticated company only; related tables must join on both record identifier and company identifier.
global_rules.model_access: Code-owned reporting vocabulary and typed selections only. No raw SQL execution, retrieved records or private documents in model prompts.
global_rules.leave_reason_exception: Only authenticated Admin/Super Admin with existing leave-read permission in their own company. All query positions and exports enforce this rule.
global_rules.output: Shared tables, suitable complete-result bar/pie charts, private reauthorized Excel/PDF exports. No module-specific parser or question training.
global_rules.limits: 100 rows/page; native exports at most 5000 rows; SQL statement timeout 5 seconds. Canonical adapters retain their own workload limits.

modules.access: Existing attendance/leave read and export permissions and employee visibility. Leave is bundled with Attendance.
modules.calculation: Calendar attendance preserves shifts, holidays, leave and overrides. Unclassified is not absent. Headcount is current; leave duration is whole-request duration for overlapping requests.
